questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Accenture, Dragos and/or runZero.
Outline your views on how closely the following parties compete: a) Accenture and Dragos (including Phosphorus); b)Accenture and runZero; c) Dragos (including Phosphorus) and runZero.
Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisitions on competition, including if there are not many alternatives or if one of the parties is a major supplier to competitors of another.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisitions.
